using UnityEngine;using CampusSim;
internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand {public void Execute(ExecutionResult result){foreach(var b in Object.FindObjectsByType<CampusTerrainBinding>(FindObjectsSortMode.None))if(b.kind==CampusTerrainBinding.BindingKind.Building&&b.name.Contains("218081857")){result.Log("BUILDING "+b.name+" pos="+b.transform.position+" source="+(b.sourceMesh?b.sourceMesh.bounds.ToString():"none")+" original="+(b.originalMesh?b.originalMesh.bounds.ToString():"none"));foreach(var t in b.GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>(true)){var r=t.GetComponent<Renderer>();var c=t.GetComponent<Collider>();if(r||c)result.Log(t.name+" parent="+t.parent?.name+" active="+t.gameObject.activeSelf+" renderer="+(r?r.enabled.ToString():"none")+" bounds="+(r?r.bounds.ToString():"none")+" collider="+(c?c.enabled.ToString():"none"));}}}}
